Quality is pride of workmanship

POREM is an authentic barbershop with two prime locations in Amsterdam, each offering unparalleled service and superior quality as top priorities. In the heart of the Jordaan, at the corner of Marnixstraat and Nieuwe Willemsstraat, you'll find a cozy and charming space where a team of skilled barbers delivers top-tier grooming experiences. Now also near Dam Square, POREM's second location brings the same warm welcome and expertise to an even broader clientele. Whether you're looking for a sharp new haircut or a refreshing shave, every service is performed with the utmost care, precision, and style.

Products and gifts

At POREM Barbershop, we don’t just provide exceptional grooming services—we also offer a carefully curated range of products to keep you looking sharp long after your visit. Our selection includes top-quality hair and styling products, with a special focus on the renowned Uppercut Deluxe line. Perfect for maintaining your look, these products are trusted by professionals and loved by clients for their performance and versatility.

Porem T-shirts and giftcards

In addition to grooming essentials, we offer exclusive wide-fit POREM T-shirts , combining comfort with style, and making them a must-have for fans of the POREM experience. Looking for the perfect gift? Our POREM gift cards are a great way to share the ultimate grooming experience with someone special.

All of these products are available in-store, so be sure to check them out during your visit. Whether you're looking to style, refresh, or gift, we’ve got something for everyone.

Book appointment

Coffee to-go and porem baristas

At our Dam Square location, we’re taking the barbershop experience to the next level with our in-house barista! Whether you’re in the mood for a rich espresso, a creamy cappuccino, or your favorite specialty coffee, we’ve got you covered. Just walk into our shop and order your coffee to-go—it’s quick, delicious, and perfect for those on the move.


If you’re staying for a haircut, why not enjoy your coffee while you relax in the barber’s chair? It’s the perfect way to enhance your grooming experience, combining great taste with top-tier service. Whether you're stopping by for a trim or simply grabbing a cup of coffee, our barista ensures every visit to POREM is a treat.
